title: Why Soft Skills Matter More Than Qualifications

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于 2022 年完成了该课程，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: What if one of the biggest mistakes we make in our careers is assuming that experience always beats fresh thinking?
sentences.zh: 如果我们职业生涯中犯下的最大错误之一是认为经验总是胜过新鲜思维，那会怎样？

sentences.en: Because some of the most valuable things you can bring to a team may not be the things you've learned over decades.
sentences.zh: 因为你能带给团队的一些最有价值的东西，可能并不是你几十年来学到的那些知识。

sentences.en: They might be your curiosity, your perspective, and your ability to connect with others.
sentences.zh: 它们可能是你的好奇心、你的视角，以及你与他人建立联系的能力。

sentences.en: In this episode, clinical psychologist Cliff Hawkins and I are taking a deep dive into soft skills
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，临床心理学家 Cliff Hawkins 和我将深入探讨软技能，

sentences.en: and how they might just be the difference that makes the difference when it comes to psychology, work and life.
sentences.zh: 以及它们如何在心理学、工作和生活中成为产生差异的关键所在。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《心理学实际上》（Psychology Actually）。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologist, and I'm joined by fellow qualified clinical psychologist, Cliff Hawkins.
sentences.zh: 我是合格的临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，今天和我一起的是同样合格的临床心理学家 Cliff Hawkins。

sentences.en: Hi, Cliff.
sentences.zh: 你好，Cliff。

sentences.en: Hello, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 你好，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here, and thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你能来，也谢谢你。

sentences.en: We first got chatting, I think, on LinkedIn, and it was a really interesting idea that actually,
sentences.zh: 我想我们最初是在 LinkedIn 上聊起来的，当时有一个非常有趣的想法，就是，

sentences.en: whether we are too caught up in the idea of how long you've been qualified or what your experiences are, and whether we should be thinking in a different way about that.
sentences.zh: 我们是否太纠结于你获得资格的时间长短或你的经验，以及我们是否应该对此有不同的思考方式。

sentences.en: Can you tell us a bit more, Cliff?
sentences.zh: 你能多告诉我们一些吗，Cliff？

sentences.en: Although it did make me think back to my NHS days and thinking if I had an assistant or trainee psychologist working with me,
sentences.zh: 虽然这确实让我想起了我在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的日子，当时我在想，如果我有一个助理或实习心理学家和我一起工作，

sentences.en: I'd probably be involving that person in the work, whereas because of the piece of work, I was commissioned to do it independently by myself.
sentences.zh: 我可能会让那个人参与到工作中来，但因为那项工作是被委托给我独立完成的，

sentences.en: I didn't have that facility open to me, and I do miss the opportunity to work with assistants and trainee psychologists
sentences.zh: 我没有那种便利条件，我确实很怀念与助理和实习心理学家一起工作的机会，

sentences.en: because they bring so much more to the party, and I've always found that I learnt from them, at least as much as they were learning from me.
sentences.zh: 因为他们为团队带来了更多东西，我一直发现我从他们身上学到的，至少和他们从我身上学到的一样多。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Just before we hit record, I was saying that one of my supervisors during my trainee years had just said,
sentences.zh: 就在我们开始录音之前，我还在说，我实习期间的一位导师曾说过，

sentences.en: I really love it when we get trainees and when we get new assistants, so that we've got that energy, that new influx of ideas,
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢我们有实习生和新助理加入的时候，因为我们能获得那种活力，那种新思想的涌入，

sentences.en: you know, new ideas of things that are working in other departments that I'm not familiar with,
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于其他部门正在运作但我不熟悉的事物的新想法，

sentences.en: or just, yeah, like almost giving us that permission to push the envelope a little bit and bring that
sentences.zh: 或者只是，是的，就像是给了我们一点突破常规的许可，并带来那种，

sentences.en: and to not think about it as just a top-down service where the knowledge is only ever imparted from above.
sentences.zh: 不要把它仅仅看作是一个自上而下的服务，知识只从上面传授下来。

sentences.en: And I guess if we've got people that might be listening earlier in their career to think,
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我们有职业生涯较早期的听众，他们可能会想，

sentences.en: actually, maybe I've got stuff that maybe I have, you know, I might not have been a qualified psychologist for years,
sentences.zh: 其实，也许我也有一些东西，你知道，我可能没有做过多年的合格心理学家，

sentences.en: but I've got, you know, relatable, transferable skills that these other people in the team might not have and that they might think of me as an asset.
sentences.zh: 但我有，你知道，可关联的、可迁移的技能，团队里的其他人可能没有，他们可能会认为我是一项资产。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is difficult, particularly for people trying to break into the NHS because the NHS traditionally is a very bureaucratic and indeed patriarchal organisation,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这很困难，特别是对于那些试图进入 NHS 的人来说，因为 NHS 传统上是一个非常官僚，甚至可以说是父权制的组织，

sentences.en: a very old-fashioned organisation in how it's built up and how it's developed.
sentences.zh: 一个在建立和发展方式上非常老派的组织。

sentences.en: And so there can be a risk of assuming that if someone has simply been there longer than anyone else, that they must be the best qualified for a particular job.
sentences.zh: 因此，可能会有一种风险，即假设如果某人仅仅是在那里待的时间比别人长，那么他们一定是最适合特定工作的人。

sentences.en: And of course, we know from the real world that that isn't necessarily the case.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们从现实世界中知道，情况未必如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's making me think about a couple of things really during my trainee years.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实让我在实习期间想到了几件事。

sentences.en: And obviously, if you're doing the assistant psychologist route,
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你走的是助理心理学家的路线，

sentences.en: then you're used to knowing that you scored, you know, first or second best to be able to get that highly competitive job.
sentences.zh: 那么你习惯于知道你得分是第一或第二，才能获得那份竞争极其激烈的工作。

sentences.en: And you've usually met the person who's going to be your supervisor or manager at the interview.
sentences.zh: 而且你通常在面试时就见过将成为你主管或经理的人。

sentences.en: So there's some aspect of having been, you know, hand-selected and chosen.
sentences.zh: 所以，这其中有一些被精挑细选的成分。

sentences.en: That's not usually the case if you then go on placement as a trainee.
sentences.zh: 如果你随后作为实习生去实习，情况通常并非如此。

sentences.en: And often you are sometimes called the trainee or the trainees.
sentences.zh: 而且你有时经常被称为“实习生”或“实习生们”。

sentences.en: And it's that idea that you don't really have an identity of your own and that you could have been a puzzle piece that's just slotted in.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是你并没有真正属于自己的身份，你可能只是一个被塞进去的拼图块。

sentences.en: And I mean, I think that's really tricky.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为这真的很棘手。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, it reminds me a bit of the sitcom Amanda Land, where the parents at the school aren't talked about or to by their name.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这让我想起了一点情景喜剧《Amanda Land》，学校里的父母们不是用他们的名字来称呼或交谈的。

sentences.en: They're just Damien's mother or Adrian's father.
sentences.zh: 他们只是“Damien 的妈妈”或“Adrian 的爸爸”。

sentences.en: They don't have an identity of their own outside being a parent.
sentences.zh: 除了作为父母，他们没有自己的身份。

sentences.en: And I think, as you say, the NHS is quite good at putting people into boxes and not really thinking about who people are as individuals and what they might be bringing.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正如你所说，NHS 很擅长把人放进盒子里，而不去真正思考人们作为个体是谁，以及他们可能带来了什么。

sentences.en: I think it's the idea that you are valued and you have value and that you matter,
sentences.zh: 我认为关键在于你被重视，你有价值，你很重要，

sentences.en: even if you haven't necessarily been chosen for that particular role or service.
sentences.zh: 即使你未必是因为那个特定的角色或服务而被选中的。

sentences.en: And empowering yourself to think, well, what can I learn?
sentences.zh: 并赋予自己力量去思考，嗯，我能学到什么？

sentences.en: What can I demonstrate?
sentences.zh: 我能展示什么？

sentences.en: And I think it is really tricky during training because I don't know what your experiences are like and how you've seen this play out in your own training and other people's.
sentences.zh: 我认为在培训期间这真的很棘手，因为我不知道你的经历是什么样的，也不知道你在自己的培训和其他人的培训中是如何看到这种情况的。

sentences.en: But I certainly when I was in my intellectual disabilities placement, I was on my third placement in my second year and very much felt I should know more.
sentences.zh: 但我肯定，当我在智力障碍实习时，那是我第二年的第三次实习，我非常强烈地感觉到我应该知道更多。

sentences.en: Like, I'm going out to kind of residential facilities as, you know, the trainee clinical psychologist who's going to really help them with their probleMs.
sentences.zh: 就像，我作为一名实习临床心理学家去往各种居住设施，去真正帮助他们解决问题。

sentences.en: But I had never worked in a service for people with intellectual disabilities.
sentences.zh: 但我从未在为智障人士提供的服务机构中工作过。

sentences.en: And so it was really, I think, a very humbling experience because I had to just think about, I guess, my soft skills, my transferable skills.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这确实是一次非常谦卑的经历，因为我不得不思考，我想，我的软技能，我的可迁移技能。

sentences.en: And it's very interesting to me that by the time I finished that six month placement,
sentences.zh: 对我来说非常有趣的是，当我完成那六个月的实习时，

sentences.en: the team wanted to be able to create a job for me to have me back kind of when I was qualified.
sentences.zh: 团队希望能够为我创造一个职位，让我合格后回来工作。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the timeline didn't align as NHS jobs often don't.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，时间线并没有对齐，NHS 的工作往往就是这样。

sentences.en: But that, I think, really did me the power of good to think, well, maybe it isn't the magic things that I might have in my toolbox that matter.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，这对我来说确实大有裨益，让我思考，嗯，也许我工具箱里那些神奇的东西并不重要。

sentences.en: Maybe I guess I am enough and it isn't just the things I've done that make me a good enough trainee and will make me a good enough qualified psych.
sentences.zh: 也许我猜我本身就足够了，不仅仅是我做过的事情让我成为一个足够好的实习生，并让我成为一个足够好的合格心理学家。

sentences.en: Well, I think I think you make an extremely important point there, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为你提出了一个非常重要的观点，Marianne。

sentences.en: And I think it's interesting that we refer to certain attributes as soft skills and the implication can be that they're somehow easier or less important than the hard skills.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有趣的是，我们将某些属性称为软技能，其含义可能是它们比硬技能更容易或更不重要。

sentences.en: Although actually, in my experience, the hard skills are easier to learn.
sentences.zh: 尽管实际上，以我的经验来看，硬技能更容易学习。

sentences.en: So, for example, I've been really struggling to get a plumber.
sentences.zh: 比如，我一直很难找到一个水管工。

sentences.en: It's quite easy to get a plumber who has the hard skills, who knows how to fix taps and things like that.
sentences.zh: 找一个有硬技能的水管工很容易，比如知道怎么修水龙头之类的。

sentences.en: What I find it really difficult is to find a plumber who has certain soft skills, such as calling me back when they say they're going to.
sentences.zh: 但我发现很难找到具备某些软技能的水管工，比如答应回电就真的会回电。

sentences.en: And it might sound a trivial thing, but I'm a busy person.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能是一件小事，但我是一个大忙人。

sentences.en: I don't have time to wait around for a plumber to decide when that person will come and work with me.
sentences.zh: 我没时间等着水管工来决定什么时候上门为我服务。

sentences.en: I need someone who will come, who will work to my agenda.
sentences.zh: 我需要一个能按我的时间表来工作的人。

sentences.en: And so I think we often underestimate the soft skills.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们经常低估了软技能的重要性。

sentences.en: And the danger there is that aspiring psychologists and even qualified psychologists can neglect the soft skills.
sentences.zh: 危险在于，有抱负的心理学家，甚至是有资质的心理学家，都可能忽视这些软技能。

sentences.en: And I often say to trainees and assistants, the most important thing is to be reliable, which means being on time, which means keeping your promises,
sentences.zh: 我经常对实习生和助理说，最重要的事情是靠谱，这意味着准时，意味着信守承诺，

sentences.en: not arriving at ten past nine for a nine o'clock meeting.
sentences.zh: 而不是九点的会议九点十分才到。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter how many degrees you've got, people will get irritated if you're consistently late for meetings.
sentences.zh: 无论你拥有多少学位，如果你总是开会迟到，人们都会感到恼火。

sentences.en: Yeah, because it doesn't feel like you've been appropriately respected, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为我觉得这让人感觉没有得到应有的尊重。

sentences.en: And it does get people's backs up, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 这确实会让人反感，不是吗？

sentences.en: When I've worked in teams when someone's consistently late or, I guess, goes out for many, many cigarette breaks.
sentences.zh: 当我和团队一起工作时，如果有人总是迟到，或者，我想，总是出去抽烟。

sentences.en: And then other people in the team maybe don't smoke or only smoke outside of work hours.
sentences.zh: 而团队里的其他人可能不抽烟，或者只在工作时间之外抽烟。

sentences.en: Like it's kind of hard to have that that team harmony and resentment can can build, can't it?
sentences.zh: 要保持团队和谐就很难了，怨气也会随之产生，对吧？

sentences.en: Very, very much so.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of the people we work with are very disempowered.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们共事的很多人都感到非常无力。

sentences.en: I remember watching a drama, a play that had been put on by people with intellectual disabilities a number of years ago.
sentences.zh: 我记得几年前看过一部由智障人士表演的戏剧。

sentences.en: And it was the play itself was of a case conference, a multidisciplinary meeting.
sentences.zh: 剧的内容是一场病例研讨会，也就是多学科会议。

sentences.en: And it started.
sentences.zh: 戏开始了。

sentences.en: And then one of the actors came in breathlessly a few minutes later and said, oh, sorry, I'm late.
sentences.zh: 然后其中一名演员气喘吁吁地迟到了几分钟，说，哦，抱歉，我迟到了。

sentences.en: I'm the social worker.
sentences.zh: 我是社会工作者。

sentences.en: And of course, everyone in the audience laughed because the stereotype was, well, the social worker will be late.
sentences.zh: 当然，观众席上的所有人都笑了，因为刻板印象就是，社会工作者总是会迟到。

sentences.en: And and so although it was making a comedy point, it was a very serious point as well that these people with intellectual disabilities were used to not being respected at all.
sentences.zh: 虽然这是一种喜剧效果，但它也表达了一个非常严肃的观点，即这些智障人士已经习惯了完全不被尊重。

sentences.en: And although it was a social worker in that scenario, in my experience, unfortunately, it could just as easily have been a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 虽然在那部戏里是社会工作者，但根据我的经验，不幸的是，换成临床心理学家也完全一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think I probably have a natural tendency to be a bit later, but I make sure that I am not late because I was raised by a late mother.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我可能天生就有点容易迟到，但我会确保自己不迟到，因为我母亲就是一个迟到的人。

sentences.en: And, you know, would drop me at swimming lessons.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她会送我去上游泳课。

sentences.en: And I might be on time for the swimming lesson, but she wouldn't be on time to come and get me because she would do this or I went to do this.
sentences.zh: 我可能准时到了游泳课，但她接我时却不准时，因为她总是在忙这个忙那个。

sentences.en: And she kind of wouldn't stay and be present.
sentences.zh: 她总是无法停下来专注于当下。

sentences.en: And and I was used to, you know, being dropped off to work late or being picked up from work late.
sentences.zh: 我习惯了被送去上学迟到，或者被接回家迟到。

sentences.en: And I don't want that to have other people have that experience of me.
sentences.zh: 我不希望别人在我身上也有这种经历。

sentences.en: And I don't want my children.
sentences.zh: 我也不希望我的孩子们……

sentences.en: I guess this is how trauma works, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我想这就是创伤的作用方式，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't want my children to have that experience of, you know, oh, well, they're always late.
sentences.zh: 我不希望我的孩子们有那种经历，你知道，哦，好吧，他们总是迟到。

sentences.en: I didn't enjoy that, you know, because when I guess and I guess this is interesting for for reflection on clients attending services.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢那样，你知道，因为当我想……我想这对反思客户参加服务的情况很有趣。

sentences.en: If they if they are younger, if they're minors, you know, that doesn't reflect on them always, does it?
sentences.zh: 如果他们年纪较小，是未成年人，你知道，这并不总是反映他们自己的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: It's often about who is bringing them.
sentences.zh: 这通常取决于带他们来的人。

sentences.en: So I have to make sure that I factor in the extra time it takes to do the things that we'll often forget.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须确保把我们经常忘记做的事情所花费的额外时间考虑进去。

sentences.en: We have to do like find our shoes, get our bag, make sure we've got our phone or a charger and brush my teeth and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们必须做的事情，比如找鞋子、拿包、确保带了手机或充电器，还要刷牙，你知道，

sentences.en: look in the mirror to check my hair's looking all right.
sentences.zh: 照照镜子看看头发是否整齐。

sentences.en: So I have to almost make an active decision to tack that extra bit on because it was always that bit that my mum would be late by.
sentences.zh: 所以我几乎必须主动决定多预留出那一点时间，因为我母亲总是会迟到那么久。

sentences.en: And I just I just don't want that.
sentences.zh: 我只是……我只是不想要那样。

sentences.en: I'm not willing to continue to perpetuate that cycle.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意继续延续那个循环。

sentences.en: But also I'm not willing to have people hold me in mind like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不愿意让人们那样看待我。

sentences.en: OK, so we thought about kind of soft skills and how they might be very much underrated.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们思考了软技能以及它们为何被严重低估。

sentences.en: Are there any other kind of bits and pieces that you think we might be overlooking, Claire?
sentences.zh: 克莱尔，你认为还有什么我们可能忽略的细节吗？

sentences.en: Well, one of one of the soft skills that I think does get underestimated is is carpe deum, seize the day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为被低估的软技能之一就是“及时行乐”（Carpe Diem），抓住机会。

sentences.en: Lots of times in my career and I appreciate it helps that I've got the privilege of being white and male and sounding middle class.
sentences.zh: 在我的职业生涯中，很多时候——我很感激自己拥有白人、男性且听起来像中产阶级的特权——

sentences.en: Lots of times I've applied for things and I've got things and I've been surprised to think, well, I was the only person apparently who applied,
sentences.zh: 很多时候我申请了职位并得到了机会，我感到惊讶，因为我想，好吧，我似乎是唯一申请的人，

sentences.en: even though I'm sure there are other people out there more qualified.
sentences.zh: 尽管我相信外面还有其他更合格的人。

sentences.en: So, for example, last week I bumped into a support worker who I found out had a psychology degree and I said, OK, send me an email and I'll see what I can do to help you.
sentences.zh: 比如，上周我偶遇了一位支持工作者，发现他有心理学学位，我说，好的，给我发封邮件，我会尽力帮你。

sentences.en: Now, I'm used to doing that and I'm used to not hearing from those people.
sentences.zh: 现在，我习惯这样做，也习惯了不再收到这些人的回音。

sentences.en: And I always think, well, what an opportunity they're potentially missing that I, you know, I know lots of people I could potentially be helpful.
sentences.zh: 我总是想，他们可能错过了多好的机会啊，你知道，我认识很多人，我本可以提供帮助的。

sentences.en: Now, as it turned out, this particular graduate has emailed me with a very, a very, a very appropriate email.
sentences.zh: 结果，这位毕业生给我发了一封非常得体的邮件。

sentences.en: And so that will make me inclined to give that person a bit of my time and who knows how helpful that might be.
sentences.zh: 这会让我倾向于花点时间在他身上，谁知道这会有多大帮助呢。

sentences.en: And I think often people don't have the confidence.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们往往缺乏自信。

sentences.en: And again, I appreciate I have multiple privileges, which perhaps perhaps have imbued me with a certain confidence that other people might not have.
sentences.zh: 同样，我很感激自己拥有多重特权，这或许赋予了我某种其他人可能没有的自信。

sentences.en: However, going after opportunities, not not letting opportunities pass one by, I think I think is a crucial skill,
sentences.zh: 然而，去追求机会，不让机会溜走，我认为这是一项至关重要的技能，

sentences.en: given how competitive we know it is to become a professional psychologist, any type of professional psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们都知道成为一名专业心理学家——任何类型的专业心理学家——竞争是多么激烈。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it kind of making me think of when I work with people, contact me and say, how can I get my foot in the door?
sentences.zh: 这让我想起当人们联系我并问我如何才能入行时。

sentences.en: And I think if someone's already working like as an HCA, so a health care assistant on a ward or doing bank work, I'm always like, well, if you're already working, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果有人已经在做医疗助理（HCA），比如在病房工作或做临时工，我总是说，好吧，如果你已经在工作了，你知道，

sentences.en: doing one to one ops or kind of regularly working with a particular client who, you know, is open to clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 做一对一护理，或者定期与某个对临床心理学开放的特定客户工作。

sentences.en: Can you start to say to the psychologists, would I be able to come into the MDT formulation when you're discussing this client?
sentences.zh: 你可以开始对心理学家说，当你们讨论这个客户时，我能参加多学科团队（MDT）的病例制定吗？

sentences.en: Because then you're getting that experience of seeing how this is applied in reality,
sentences.zh: 因为这样你就能获得经验，看到这些理论在现实中是如何应用的，

sentences.en: but also that you might be able to feed in your kind of examples and insights and reflections of this person.
sentences.zh: 而且你可能还能贡献你对这个人的观察、见解和反思。

sentences.en: And they might really value that because you might be seeing things differently than they are.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会非常重视这一点，因为你看到的可能与他们不同。

sentences.en: And it's not just that you are trying to take from that experience.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是你试图从那种经历中获取什么。

sentences.en: It really is that actually we think you've got really interesting insight and you might benefit our team discussions.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们确实认为你有非常有趣的见解，可能会对我们的团队讨论有所帮助。

sentences.en: But unless you think to kind of say that you'd be happy to do that, you'd be willing to do that, that opportunity might not necessarily come directly to you.
sentences.zh: 但除非你主动提出你愿意这样做，否则那个机会可能不会直接降临到你身上。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, because people like you and me have got limited time and we're unlikely to chase people who who might be asking us for things.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为像你我这样的人时间有限，我们不太可能去追着那些可能向我们寻求帮助的人。

sentences.en: It might be necessary to for people to chase us and that might make the difference.
sentences.zh: 人们可能需要主动来找我们，而这可能就是关键所在。

sentences.en: Someone who is assertive enough to, for example, send the email after after approaching me and to send an appropriate email as well.
sentences.zh: 比如，有人在联系我之后，能够主动跟进并发送一封得体的邮件，这种积极主动的态度就很好。

sentences.en: An email that makes me think, yes, this person, I think, will make a good clinical psychologist in the future.
sentences.zh: 如果这封邮件能让我觉得：没错，我觉得这个人未来会成为一名优秀的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: So I'm I'm prepared to put myself out to give them some help for free.
sentences.zh: 那么，我愿意投入时间，免费为他们提供一些帮助。

sentences.en: Whereas if someone either didn't email me or it was perhaps a badly written or badly spelt email, then I'd be less likely to to give that help.
sentences.zh: 反之，如果有人根本不给我发邮件，或者邮件写得一塌糊涂、错字连篇，那我提供帮助的可能性就会降低。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's about making it bespoke and personalised, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 没错，我觉得关键在于要做到量身定制和个性化，对吧？

sentences.en: So in this days of kind of AI and ChatGPT, it's kind of easy to tell whether this feels like it's something that's been written by a person.
sentences.zh: 在如今这个人工智能和ChatGPT盛行的时代，很容易就能分辨出这是否出自真人手笔。

sentences.en: And so just really, you know, empower yourself to be yourself, to use yourself kind of as that intervention, as part of the tool to get you what you want.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的，你要有底气做你自己，把你自己当作一种干预手段，作为实现目标的工具的一部分。

sentences.en: I think it's also really important to hold in mind the idea that you're not an extra in your own life, kind of we should be a key player.
sentences.zh: 我认为还要时刻记住一点：你不是自己人生中的配角，我们应该是主角。

sentences.en: But to bear in mind that everyone else is is the kind of the leading actor in their own lives and they don't always have time to fully consider everyone else in the caSt.
sentences.zh: 但也要记住，其他人也是他们各自人生中的主角，他们并不总是有时间去充分顾及剧组里的每一个人。

sentences.en: And so it's kind of your job every now and then I'm here and remind people, but also know that it's OK to ask to have your needs met.
sentences.zh: 所以，偶尔提醒一下大家你的存在是你的工作，但也要知道，提出自己的需求是完全没问题的。

sentences.en: And then that gives people a chance to either meet them or politely decline that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这样也能给别人一个机会，让他们选择满足你的需求，或者礼貌地拒绝。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: OK, so we're getting a really nice collection of these soft skills.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们已经收集到了一系列非常棒的软技能。

sentences.en: Any others, Cliff?
sentences.zh: 还有其他的吗，Cliff？

sentences.en: I think another one is to keep promises.
sentences.zh: 我觉得还有一点是信守承诺。

sentences.en: For example, if I'm asked to deliver a report by certain date, I will deliver it by that date.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果有人要求我在某个日期前提交报告，我一定会按时完成。

sentences.en: There's there's no there's no doubting that that will happen.
sentences.zh: 这一点毋庸置疑，一定会做到。

sentences.en: And thinking back to people earlier in their careers, that might mean if someone asks to receive some data from you,
sentences.zh: 回想一下职业生涯早期的人，如果有人向你索要数据，

sentences.en: if you're doing some data analysis, again, get get it done by when you say you're going to, because that may be your your one opportunity to impress that individual.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在做数据分析，一定要在你承诺的时间内完成，因为这可能是你给对方留下深刻印象的唯一机会。

sentences.en: Or that may be the one opportunity to surprise that individual.
sentences.zh: 或者这可能是给对方带来惊喜的唯一机会。

sentences.en: Sometimes when people say to me, well, yes, Cliff, I'll let you have that by a certain date.
sentences.zh: 有时人们对我说：“好的，Cliff，我会在某月某日前给你。”

sentences.en: Unfortunately, sometimes I'm surprised.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，有时我反而会感到“惊喜”。

sentences.en: I'm more surprised when they do let me have it by a certain date, because I'm used to people always always providing things late.
sentences.zh: 当他们真的按时交给我时，我反而更惊讶，因为我习惯了人们总是拖延。

sentences.en: Again, coming back to the plumber, I'm more used to plumbers not ringing me back or not getting back to me by the date they say.
sentences.zh: 再回到水管工的例子，我更习惯水管工不回我电话，或者没有在约定的日期前联系我。

sentences.en: So when someone does, it's a nice surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以当有人真的做到了，那真是一个令人愉快的惊喜。

sentences.en: So we're not necessarily talking about who's the the most intellectual person to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们讨论的未必是谁才是心理学领域最聪明的人。

sentences.en: It might seem boring, but the most reliable person can actually be the most useful person to the to the people for whom we're working.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能很无聊，但最可靠的人往往是对我们服务对象最有价值的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, can't it just?
sentences.zh: 确实如此，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's reminded me that I've promised to get some quotes back to a journalist today about a certain thing.
sentences.zh: 这提醒了我，我今天答应了一位记者要回复一些引语，关于某件事的。

sentences.en: And I've I've had to add that to my own Trello board and set myself a reminder because it's important for me to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不得不把它加到我自己的Trello看板上，并给自己设了个提醒，因为对我来说，能够做到这一点很重要。

sentences.en: But also, I've said I'm going to do that.
sentences.zh: 而且，我已经承诺过要做了。

sentences.en: And so I want to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望能做到。

sentences.en: Yeah, very much so.
sentences.zh: 确实非常重要。

sentences.en: OK, Cliff, are there any kind of models or ways of kind of holding all of this stuff in mind?
sentences.zh: 好的，Cliff，有没有什么模型或方法可以把这些东西都记在心里？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: one one thing that I've been lucky enough to do in my career is to spend some time completely out of health care for a number of years working as a management consultant in industry.
sentences.zh: 我职业生涯中很幸运的一件事，就是有几年完全脱离了医疗保健行业，在工业界担任管理顾问。

sentences.en: And also as part of that time, I did an MBA.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，我还攻读了MBA。

sentences.en: And although I now work primarily clinically, I still do work organizationally as well.
sentences.zh: 虽然我现在主要从事临床工作，但我仍然会从组织层面进行思考。

sentences.en: And even when I'm working clinically, I bring that organizational experience and and training and learning to bear.
sentences.zh: 即使在进行临床工作时，我也会运用那些组织经验、培训和学习成果。

sentences.en: So, for example, there's a model known as the seven S's developed by the McKinsey Management Consultancy.
sentences.zh: 例如，麦肯锡管理咨询公司开发了一个名为“7S模型”的模型。

sentences.en: And you reminded me of it, Marianne, when you talked about soft skills.
sentences.zh: Marianne，你谈到软技能时，让我想起了这个模型。

sentences.en: And with that seven S model, which people can Google, there are three what are called hard S's.
sentences.zh: 在这个7S模型中（大家可以去谷歌搜索），有三个所谓的“硬S”。

sentences.en: And that's the the the strategy that an organization has that then leads to the structure of that organization and the systems that enable that structure to work.
sentences.zh: 那就是组织的战略，它决定了组织的结构，以及支撑该结构运作的系统。

sentences.en: And those three hard S's are all vital, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这三个硬S至关重要。

sentences.en: However, they won't be sufficient for any organization unless the organization pays at least the same amount of attention to the four soft S's.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果组织不至少同等重视四个“软S”，那么任何组织都无法取得成功。

sentences.en: And the first soft S's is is staff or could be people getting the right people in the right place at the right time and making sure that those staff have the right skills.
sentences.zh: 第一个软S是员工（Staff），或者说是人员，即在正确的时间将正确的人放在正确的位置，并确保这些员工具备相应的技能。

sentences.en: They might come with the right skills or we might have to develop those skills.
sentences.zh: 他们可能自带技能，也可能需要我们去培养。

sentences.en: And then what about shared values?
sentences.zh: 那么“共同价值观”（Shared Values）呢？

sentences.en: How are those people fitting into the organization or how does the organization evolve to take account of new shared values?
sentences.zh: 这些人如何融入组织？或者组织如何演变以适应新的共同价值观？

sentences.en: And what's the style of the organization?
sentences.zh: 还有组织的风格（Style）是什么？

sentences.en: What's the style of the person?
sentences.zh: 个人的风格又是什么？

sentences.en: So, for example, someone who's going to work with me will have to be reliable.
sentences.zh: 比如，要和我共事的人必须可靠。

sentences.en: I'm not interested in flaky.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢靠不住的人。

sentences.en: I don't want brilliant, flaky people.
sentences.zh: 我不想要那种才华横溢却不可靠的人。

sentences.en: I want steady, reliable people.
sentences.zh: 我想要的是稳重、可靠的人。

sentences.en: And so I think remembering those seven S's is crucial for anyone leading an organization.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，对于任何领导组织的人来说，记住这7S至关重要。

sentences.en: However, it's also good to bear in mind for someone at the start of their career as well, because I think at any stage of our career,
sentences.zh: 不过，对于职业生涯刚起步的人来说，这也是很好的参考，因为我认为在职业生涯的任何阶段，

sentences.en: paying attention to each of those seven S's and thinking, where do my strengths lie?
sentences.zh: 关注这7S中的每一项，思考自己的优势在哪里，

sentences.en: What can I bring into an organization?
sentences.zh: 我能为组织带来什么？

sentences.en: One doesn't have to be good at all seven.
sentences.zh: 一个人不必在七个方面都表现出色。

sentences.en: However, I guess anyone with a psychology degree is going to be good at some of those seven.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想任何拥有心理学学位的人，在其中某些方面都会很擅长。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's making me think that would make a really nice kind of way of, I don't know, interacting in an interview,
sentences.zh: 没错，这让我想起，这在面试中会是一个非常好的互动方式，

sentences.en: especially for that, you know, the end bit that's always a bit awkward.
sentences.zh: 尤其是针对最后那个总是有点尴尬的环节。

sentences.en: Have you got any questions or have you got anything else you want to say?
sentences.zh: “你有什么问题吗？”或者“你还有什么想说的吗？”

sentences.en: And actually being able to demonstrate some of those softer skills and using that model,
sentences.zh: 实际上，能够展示出这些软技能并运用这个模型，

sentences.en: because I always think it's really nice in an answer to be able to weave in like a little bit of theory or, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为我总觉得在回答问题时，如果能融入一点理论，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: demonstrate how you can use this complex psychological knowledge.
sentences.zh: 展示你如何运用这些复杂的心理学知识，会非常棒。

sentences.en: So I think that would be a great tip, an idea for someone.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这对大家来说会是一个很棒的建议和思路。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time in speaking with us, Cliff.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间与我们交谈，Cliff。

sentences.en: I've loved it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这次谈话。

sentences.en: Where can we learn more about you and your work?
sentences.zh: 我们可以在哪里了解更多关于你和你的工作？

sentences.en: If you, if you go to my website, you'll find some, some, some things in the blog section of it, which you might find interesting and a whole stack of other stuff.
sentences.zh: 如果你访问我的网站，你会发现博客部分有一些你可能会感兴趣的内容，还有一大堆其他资料。

sentences.en: My website is www.cliffhawkinspsychology.com.
sentences.zh: My website is www.cliffhawkinspsychology.com.

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太完美了。

sentences.en: Cliffhawkinspsychology.com.
sentences.zh: Cliffhawkinspsychology.com.

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'll make sure that I link all of that in the description and the show notes.
sentences.zh: 我会确保在描述和节目笔记中附上所有链接。

sentences.en: But thank you again for your time in speaking with me.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你抽出时间与我交谈。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，Marianne。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much again to my guest, Cliff Hawkins.
sentences.zh: 再次非常感谢我的嘉宾，Cliff Hawkins。

sentences.en: Please do go and follow him over on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 请务必去LinkedIn上关注他。

sentences.en: If you are curious about the psychology career journeys of clinical psychologists and other HCPC psychologists,
sentences.zh: 如果你对临床心理学家和其他HCPC注册心理学家的职业历程感到好奇，

sentences.en: I think you will really like the Clinical Psychologist Collective book.
sentences.zh: 我想你会非常喜欢《临床心理学家集体》（Clinical Psychologist Collective）这本书。

sentences.en: And if you have read that or any of my other books,
sentences.zh: 如果你读过这本书或我的其他任何书籍，

sentences.en: I'd be so grateful if you consider leaving me an Amazon or Goodreads review.
sentences.zh: 如果你能考虑在亚马逊或Goodreads上给我留下评论，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring psychologist yourself and you love the nuance and the reflection and the ability to formulate that being around clinical psychologists gives you,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位有抱负的心理学家，并且热爱临床心理学家所带来的细微差别、反思能力和构思能力，

sentences.en: I think you'll really love the Aspiring Psychologist membership, which you can join from just £30 a month with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 我想你会非常喜欢“有抱负的心理学家”会员计划，每月仅需30英镑起，且无最低期限要求。

sentences.en: And the membership really does get real results for people.
sentences.zh: 这个会员计划确实能为人们带来实实在在的成果。

sentences.en: Check out my Google reviews for the Aspiring Psychologist website.
sentences.zh: 去看看“有抱负的心理学家”网站上的谷歌评价吧。

sentences.en: At the time of recording this, I've just had the tenth person this academic cycle confirm that they have been offered at least one place on the doctorate in clinical psychology.
sentences.zh: 在录制这期节目时，我刚刚收到本学年第十个人的确认，他们至少获得了一个临床心理学博士项目的录取名额。

sentences.en: So they are going to be trainee clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 所以他们即将成为临床心理学实习生。

sentences.en: And we are not a big membership, so that is a massive figure.
sentences.zh: 我们的会员规模并不大，所以这是一个非常了不起的数字。

sentences.en: If you would like to be in that position next year, please do consider joining us.
sentences.zh: 如果你明年也想达到这个目标，请务必考虑加入我们。

sentences.en: There's no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 没有最低期限要求。

sentences.en: You can join from just £30 a month and I will look forward to supporting you.
sentences.zh: 每月仅需30英镑起即可加入，我期待着为你提供支持。

sentences.en: And if you've enjoyed this episode, I think you will really enjoy this one too.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这一集，我想你也会非常喜欢这一集。

sentences.en: I'm chatting with Dr. Adam McCartney, a qualified educational psychologist, about wellbeing at work and how we can reduce burnout.
sentences.zh: 我正在与合格的教育心理学家Adam McCartney博士聊天，讨论职场幸福感以及我们如何减少职业倦怠。

sentences.en: I think you'll love it.
sentences.zh: 我想你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-money programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022, and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie提供的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组大师班、大师课、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
